name: Claude Usage
description: Claude Code usage widget with Anthropic Authorization Code OAuth + PKCE, multi-account support, five-hour, weekly and Fable weekly limits, and dual-quota overview/single-quota detail layouts.

localizedDescriptions.zh: Claude Code 用量小组件。支持 Anthropic OAuth、多账号、5 小时/周限/Fable 周限，以及双额度概览和单额度详情布局。
localizedDescriptions.en: Claude Code usage widget with Anthropic OAuth, multi-account support, five-hour, weekly and Fable weekly limits, plus dual-quota overview and single-quota detail layouts.
